notes.epoch_context: Epoch 1795651200 opened 2026-11-26T00:00:00Z. The Minter's active_period() reached it at block 62304194 (ts 1795651214), 14 s and 72 blocks after the first block at 00:00 (62304122); found with --find-boundary-block. No Voter event, RewardAdded or Recovered landed between 00:00 and the mint. Votes were cast during epoch 1795046400. All three boundary phases landed on-chain: run 222 (phase 1, k=4, block 62303100, T-205s), run 223 (phase 2, k=6, block 62303924, T-40s), run 224 (phase 3, k=8, block 62304046, T-16s, send-time expected $1,204.48), which is the binding allocation; lastVoted 1795651184 equals its block time. The backup vote, run 221 (2026-11-25T17:08Z, k=9, expected $1,927.42), was replaced.
notes.carryover_check: The epoch-1795046400 pot was fully claimed on 2026-11-19 (38 of 38 escrow batches), so this table should hold only this epoch's rewards; the Transfer logs in the claim receipts confirm it.
notes.headline: Realised $1,229.97 ($0.6781 per 1k votes against $0.6560 last epoch). Against run 224's realized-at-boundary entitlement of $1,229.46 it is +$0.51; all 10 tokens reconcile on amount. The claimed amounts run about 1.00002x the expected ones for every token, which matches our on-chain vote weight of 1,813,775 (the standing-votes reads at phases 2 and 3) against the 1,813,743 the review assumes; the rest of the USD difference is price movement since the boundary snapshot.

notes.price_feed: The routing-divergence audit found no unhandled persistent overprice. Phase 1's price refresh found 146 tokens still fresh and updated none (one fetch failure), and all three phases had 100% price coverage. One bribe token, sUSDVE, was absent from the snapshot and valued at $0 in the review; its only boundary bribe was 1.7e-9 tokens. The backup vote's sanity check overrode 8 prices (wtIAU, tBTC, LITCOIN, wtSPYM, wtGOOGL, wtSGOV, wtBABA, wtNVDA); none was a reward in its 9 chosen pools.
notes.claim_swap_outcome: Claimed and swapped 2026-11-26. 44 of 44 escrow claim batches successful (--claim-source escrow, 22 gauges), no retries. 21 of the gauges are the union of the four votes sent; the 22nd came only from the backup vote's dry run (run 220), which executed_allocations records with no tx, and its 2 batches received nothing. Only phase 3's 8 gauges paid (16 batches). Transfers to the wallet summed from the 44 receipts match the table for all 10 tokens (USDC 1,220.407674 against 1,220.41 displayed): gross received $1,229.97. The router-batch swap delivered 6.438802 USDC for 3 legs (wtIFX, wtNVDA, WETH) marked at $6.47 (-0.53%), against the 6.440074 quote. WETH included 0.000337 left over from last week. This epoch's FUEGO, AVNT, POD, wtTR, wtWEN and SIBYL stayed below the $1 dust threshold and were left unswapped (about $3.84). End state 1,226.846476 USDC = 1,220.407674 claimed + 6.438802 swapped, from a starting balance of 0. Gas 0.000162 ETH: 0.000154 claims, 0.000008 approvals and executeSwaps.
